facts.fact: The Tanzania Police Force and NBS issued the crime statistics report for January-December 2020 in January 2021, compiled by the Police statistics unit from crime reports received at police stations; as_of is the report's January 2021 date.
facts.system: Takwimu za Hali ya Uhalifu na Matukio ya Usalama Barabarani, Januari - Desemba 2020

facts.fact: The Police statistics unit states it receives all crimes reported at police stations nationwide, analyses and stores them, and prepares the crime situation reports; the 2020 report is dated January 2021.
facts.system: Takwimu za Hali ya Uhalifu na Matukio ya Usalama Barabarani, Januari - Desemba 2020

facts.fact: The Police statistics unit states it prepares the crime situation report every quarter, half-year and year; the January-December 2020 edition is dated January 2021.
facts.system: Takwimu za Hali ya Uhalifu na Matukio ya Usalama Barabarani, Januari - Desemba 2020
